minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  February 25, 2025

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
  February 25, 2025, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the City
  Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint Powers
  Authority at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Joint Powers
  Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts,
  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority officials and personnel
  present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Angela Allen  City Treasurer
  Louis A. Atwell  City Manager/ Executive Director*
  Jose Cortes  Assistant City Manger
  Rick R. Olivarez  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Destinee Wesley  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint Powers
  Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Joint Powers Chairman Butts inquired if there were
  any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority/Joint Powers Authority Members on any item on the Agendas.

  There was no response.

142.9  PAYMENT WARRANTS AND BILLS – RECEIVED AND FILED. The demands
  presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated February 21,
  2025, in the amount of $5,068,265.66 is hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/Successor
  Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify upon said
  registers that said demand is received and filed.

  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts ordered the
  Warrants and Bills received and filed.

301  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION AFFIRMED (EA-
  CE-2024-147); ORDINANCE NO. 25-07 INTRODUCED – ZONING CODE
  AMENDMENT NO. 24-00003 (ZCA24-00003). The City Clerk announced that the next
  scheduled matter was a public hearing to consider introduction of an Ordinance approve
  Zoning Code Amendment No. 24-00003 (ZCA24-00003) to extend the hours of the on-site
  sale of alcohol until 4:00 a.m. in the Sports and Entertainment (SE) Overlay Zone.

  Louis Atwell, City Manager presented the Staff Report dated February 25, 2025.

  Bernard McCrumby, Planning Manager, presented a brief oral report.

  Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present that wished to address the City
  Council on this matter.

  Speaker name unknown spoke regarding public safety regarding agenda Item PH-1.
 February 25, 2025

  Mayor Butts closed the public comment portion at the hour of 2:04 p.m.

  Following Discussion it was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council
  Member Faulk that the City Council does hereby Affirm Categorical Exemption (EA-CE-
  2024-147).
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  further reading be waived. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Thereupon, Ordinance No. 25-07 entitled:

  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, TO APPROVE ZONING CODE AMENDMENT ZCA-24-00003
  TO EXTEND THE HOURS OF THE ON-SITE SALE OF ALCOHOL UNTIL
  4:00 A.M. IN THE SPORTS AND ENTERTAINMENT(SE) OVERLAY ZONE

  was introduced by Mayor Butts.

171  PAYMENT AUTHORIZED – PREMIER PROPERTY PRESERVATION, LLC.
  Staff report dated February 25, 2025, was presented recommending the Mayor and Council
  Members authorize payment of an invoice to Premier Property Preservation, LLC, for daily
  janitorial services of exterior restrooms located throughout citywide parks.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby authorize payment for $45,906. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

183  PAYMENT AUTHORIZED – IPS GROUP, INC.; ANTICIPATED INVOICES
  AUTHORIZED - IPS. Staff report dated February 25, 2025, was presented recommending
  the Mayor and Council Members authorize payment of outstanding invoices to IPS Group,
  Inc, (IPS), for past monthly credit card transactions and parking meter operation fees.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Authorize payment totaling $113,818.63; and 2) Authorize
  payment of anticipated invoices to IPS, not to exceed $18,000. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

125  RESOLUTION NO. 25-53A – AMENDING THE AUTHORITY LIMITS OF THE
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE. Staff report dated February 25, 2025, was presented
  recommending the Mayor and Council Members adopt a resolution to amend the authority
  limits of the Claims Review Committee.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby adopt Resolution No. 25-53A entitled:

  A RESOLUTION FOR THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 8002 AND
  REPLACING IT WITH THIS RESOLUTION UPDATING THE PROCEDURE
  FOR REVIEW OF ALL CLAIMS AGAINST AND ON BEHALF OF THE CITY

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  2
 February 25, 2025

126  MONTHLY TREASURER’S REPORT. Staff report dated February 25, 2025, was
  presented submitting the Monthly Treasurer’s Report for the Month ending October 31,
  2024.

  Mayor Butts ordered the report received and filed.

  REPORTS – CITY CLERK. City Clerk Aisha L. Thompson expressed her heartfelt thanks
  to the Parks and Recreation Department, Thomas Uwal, Teresa Estrada, Daniel Medina,
  and all the committee members for their efforts in organizing a fantastic Black History
  Celebration. She also encouraged everyone to save the date for the 2025 Women
  Empowerment Summit, scheduled for May 3, 2025.

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished
  to address the City Council on any matter connected with City business not elsewhere
  considered on the Agenda.

  Charlene Sanders spoke regarding the Homeless on Buckthorn and La-Brea and the police
  department for assisting over the pasted weekend.

  Councilman Morales left the dais at the hour of 2:16 pm.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in honor of Rosette C. Smith and Judge Albert D. Mathews at the hour of 2:31
  p.m.

  Approved this 15th day of April, 2025.
  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
